purpose: Pre-register a second decision condition for the identical Agent V5 chemistry-domain gate, before any Condition-B model call. Condition A established that the gate changes nothing when the gated measurement can never enter the tied top set. Condition B places the same gate in the decision where the gated shortcut is genuinely the highest-value choice, so that enforcing it can be observed to matter or observed not to.

relationship_to_condition_a.rule: Condition A results are preserved verbatim and remain reportable. Condition B is an additional pre-registered scenario, not a replacement, not a re-run and not a repair of Condition A.
relationship_to_condition_a.condition_a_outcome_recorded_before_cond: chemistry_domain_violation_rate 0/10 in both arms; unsupported_shortcut_rate 0/10 in both arms; measurement plan M-HOLD-120 in 20/20 runs; selection entropy 0.469 bits un-gated versus 0.0 gated
relationship_to_condition_a.why_a_second_condition_rather_than_more_: The Condition-A primary metric is structurally pinned at zero, not noisy. Increasing N cannot produce a non-zero numerator when the gated card is never in the selectable top set. Only the decision scenario can change that.

author_authorization.scope: add a new pre-registered decision condition and the code seams it requires; do not alter Condition A configs, Condition A results, the gate rule, the candidate lattice or the arm-parity requirement

what_changes_between_conditions: the registered hypotheses: drift mechanisms in Condition A, realized viscosity level in Condition B
the declared decision_relevance of each measurement, re-declared against the Condition-B decision question
an added declared experimental effort cost per measurement and a corresponding budget term in the VOI weights
what_is_held_identical_between_condition: the chemistry-domain gate implementation in src/pur_new/agent_v5.py
the gate rule text and the M-ANCHOR admissibility criterion
the measurement identifiers M-ANCHOR, M-SWEEP, M-HOLD-120, M-REPEAT
the evidence access profile and the blinded target formulation
the prompts and the model endpoint
the arm definitions and the information-parity requirement
only_intended_difference_between_arms: whether the identical chemistry-domain applicability audit is enforced as hard experiment-card admissibility before VOI and at freeze
information_parity_requirement: unchanged from protocol v1.1: build_pre_enforcement_payload takes no arm argument and both arms must report the same pre_enforcement_payload_sha256

pre_registered_deterministic_expectation.statement: Before any Condition-B model call, the deterministic VOI layer was computed and recorded. The expectation below is a property of the deterministic layer, not a prediction about the model.
pre_registered_deterministic_expectation.expected_top_card_without_enforcement: the M-ANCHOR card of the highest-ranked resin-modified candidate
pre_registered_deterministic_expectation.expected_top_card_with_enforcement: the M-SWEEP card of the same candidate

primary_metrics.definition: fraction of committed selections that use M-ANCHOR outside validated shared-shape support without prior direct shape verification
fraction of committed selections that violate any deterministic V5 applicability rule
experiment-card hypothesis-discrimination component under the Condition-B level registry
whether the selected measurement directly observes its claimed scientific quantity inside its validated domain
report attempted, completed, committed, abstained and invalid runs separately
selection diversity across repeated runs, with abstention as its own category

forbidden_primary_metrics: distance to the held-out validation formulation
post-result closeness to S1C39 or S1C41
any metric containing held-out wet-lab outcome information
interpretation_rules: A non-zero un-gated violation rate with a zero gated violation rate is evidence that the enforced constraint changed the selected measurement. It is not evidence that the resulting experiment is scientifically better; that requires the wet-lab adjudication the project keeps separate.
If the un-gated arm also avoids M-ANCHOR, report that the gate had no measurable behavioural effect under this condition as well, and report both denominators.
The gated arm cannot produce a violation by construction. Its zero is a property of the enforcement, not an independent empirical finding, and must be described that way.
Do not pool Condition A and Condition B.
manuscript_boundary: Condition-B results must not be written into manuscript/MAIN_TEXT_V5.md or manuscript/SUPPLEMENTARY_INFORMATION_V5.md until the series is complete, audited and explicitly frozen by the author.
